name: 同行拆解
description: Tear down competitor accounts, extract real pain points, and generate scripts. Requires a Yunjinglink API key.
description_zh: 把同行的内容贴进来，拆出它的定位、客群和套路，再生成真实痛点和口播脚本。需填云境链 API Key。
description_en: Tear down competitor accounts, extract real pain points, and generate scripts. Requires a Yunjinglink API key.
examples_zh: 帮我拆一下这个同行账号，内容我贴在下面
家政行业，想入行的中年女性，给我 30 条真实痛点
用第二个痛点写一条 30 秒抖音口播脚本
examples_en: Analyze this competitor account from the text I pasted below
Give me 30 real pain points for housekeeping customers among middle-aged career changers
Turn the second pain point into a 30-second Douyin script
